This individual was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] apprentice of the [[Dread Masters]] in [[3668 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]]. When his masters, just captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], were transferred to the [[Section X]] of the [[The Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], they managed to send a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] message to their apprentice.
The apprentice hijacked the [[Fatality]], a starship full of prototype [[HK-51]] droids, and arrived over the planet in an attempt to free his masters. However, the ship was easily shot down by the prison's orbital defenses, and the ship landed on a frozen lake, killing the crew and putting the droids in stasis.
